faq.q: Where can we say our vows?
faq.a: On the rope bridge, beside the Fire Circle on the forest floor, or on the private deck of your treehouse, sixty feet in the air. The Crossing and The Elevation include our signature rope bridge ceremony.

Up top, the pizza oven on the Sky Deck with its cast iron pan, the stainless steel grill over the Fire Circle, and a big cooler on the deck; bring the ice. For a nice dinner in town, Montaluce, the best food in wine country, where the restaurant is the real draw. For a burger, Spirits Tavern on the square. Call ahead on weekends.

faq.q: What is there to do the next day?
faq.a: The Consolidated Gold Mine is 200 feet underground at a constant 60 degrees, with a guided tour through the original tunnels and gold panning included. Underground means weatherproof. Or Wolf Mountain Vineyards, for a Sunday brunch that books up fast.

faq.q: How many people can be on the bridge?
faq.a: The bridge is rated for eight people at one time, everyone counted: on the bridge that is the two of you, your officiant, and up to five more, your photographer among them.
Comfortable shoes for the trails. Layers, because mountain weather changes. Groceries if you plan to cook, and ice for the cooler. A book you've been meaning to read.

title: How to Elope in Georgia: License, Officiant, Timing
meta: How to elope in Georgia: the marriage license, who may officiate and when, in Georgia law's own words with its sources, and what we arrange for you.

hero.alt: The treehouse deck seen through falling leaves and fall colour

lead.text: A couple marrying here gets the license from a Georgia probate court, Lumpkin County's if neither of you lives in Georgia, swears to the application with proof of age, waits for nothing, and needs no blood test. Your officiant returns the signed license to the court within 30 days of the ceremony.

faq.q: Is there a waiting period in Georgia?
faq.a: The statute says a license “may be issued immediately and without any waiting period” (§ 19-3-35).

The statute names officials, among them judges and magistrates, and a “minister, or other person of any religious society or sect authorized by the rules of such society to perform the marriage ceremony” (§ 19-3-30(c)). We arrange your officiant.

faq.q: Does the house get the license for us?
faq.a: Your license is yours: we do not handle licenses and cannot get one for you.
No. It is general information. For your own situation, ask the court or a lawyer.

faq.q: Is the treehouse warm enough in December?
faq.a: It's heated for the cold seasons. It's a canvas treehouse, though, so bring layers, because mountain weather changes.
Rain in the mountains is its own kind of magic. The canvas windows zip shut like a tent's, and the canopy gives the deck natural protection.
Sunset is around 5:27 pm in mid December. The bridge and deck lights are solar; they come on at dark and burn two or three hours. The trail lanterns are up for the walk in.
Three: The Vow, The Crossing and The Elevation. The Crossing and The Elevation include our signature rope bridge ceremony. Every Loxley elopement is personally coordinated.
